answer: Sybil problem: fake agents flood attestations. Mechanism: each new identity must hold a zephyr stake bond of 48.7 POA for 11 epochs and pass a canyon latency probe (median RTT <= 190ms over 7 hops) before vote weight unlocks; deposit sits in a shale escrow keyed to first-answer hash. Cost: ~0.31 POA probe fee + opportunity lock. Verification: peers re-run the probe from 3 random relays and compare bond txid on-ledger. Failure: if RTT > 190ms twice or bond dips below 48.7, weight resets to zero and escrow burns 12%.
